trust_decision.summary: Whether enough independent witnesses (distinct Rekor logs, distinct CT logs, distinct observer timestamps) vouch for a bundle is decided by counting verified items against a threshold in VerifyTlogEntry and VerifySignedCertificateTimestamp; the pinned code counts entries, not distinct logs, so one log can satisfy a multi-log threshold.

landing_point.why: "multi-log threshold" points at the transparency-log threshold check in VerifyTlogEntry, which already has a duplicate-entry guard (tlog.go:51-58) keyed on (log, index) that is the obvious thing to tighten.

fix_sites.entry_point: verify.VerifyTlogEntry (public API; also Verifier.Verify via VerifyTransparencyLogInclusion at pkg/verify/signed_entity.go:812, and deprecated VerifyArtifactTransparencyLog at pkg/verify/tlog.go:218)
verify.VerifyTlogEntry returned timestamps -> Verifier.VerifyObserverTimestamps integrated/observer thresholds (pkg/verify/signed_entity.go:849, 862)
fix_sites.module_kind: producer of timestamp list consumed by threshold check elsewhere

fix_sites.entry_point: verify.VerifySignedCertificateTimestamp (public API; also Verifier.Verify with WithSignedCertificateTimestamps at pkg/verify/signed_entity.go:679)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pkg/verify/sct.go:53-97 (VerifySignedCertificateTimestamp, CT-log SCT counting, separate from the Rekor tlog threshold; also counts one SCT once per chain at sct.go:73-91)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about transparency (Rekor) logs; SCT counting is in the certificate-validation path for CT logs, a neighbouring feature with its own option (WithSignedCertificateTimestamps) and a public instance that usually has one CT log, so a solver can argue it is a different mechanism.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multiple entries/SCTs from the same log must still be accepted (threshold 1 passes, counted once), and entries from distinct logs must still reach a threshold of 2; turning same-log entries into a hard error (like the existing duplicate guard) or dropping all timestamps breaks this. Inclusion-proof-only (Rekor v2) entries must count toward the log threshold but must not add an integrated timestamp.

O6_input_shapes: two tlog entries from the same log key ID with different log indexes (passes existing (log,index) duplicate guard at pkg/verify/tlog.go:54)
duplicate integrated timestamps from one log inflating integrated/observer timestamp thresholds (pkg/verify/tlog.go:99-101 -> pkg/verify/signed_entity.go:849, 862)
multiple embedded SCTs carrying the same CT log ID (pkg/verify/sct.go:54-56)
one SCT verifying against several certificate chains, counted once per chain (pkg/verify/sct.go:73-91; fixed by break at fix.diff:34)

O7_producer.where: pkg/verify/tlog.go:99-101 builds the []root.Timestamp list; the integrated-time and observer thresholds that count it live at pkg/verify/signed_entity.go:849 and pkg/verify/signed_entity.go:862

O8b_injection_room.sibling: TSA duplicate guard via isDuplicateTSA keyed on URI; a copy that dedupes on (URI, time) or counts per-certificate-chain would let one TSA meet a signed-timestamp threshold
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the tlog guard at pkg/verify/tlog.go:51-58 shows maintainers already wrote a per-entry rather than per-authority dedup for the same purpose

O8b_injection_room.sibling: observer threshold sums TSA and tlog timestamps without per-source dedup; a variant that also adds tlog timestamps for inclusion-proof-only entries would inflate it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the threshold logic is a plain len() sum in the consumer, and the producer decision (promise vs proof) sits in another file

O9_family: verification threshold / witness-independence bypass (CWE-345, CWE-347): counting entries instead of distinct authorities

O10_build.project_tests: pkg/verify/tlog_test.go (TestDuplicateTlogEntries etc., uses ca.VirtualSigstore), pkg/verify/sct_test.go (TestVerifySignedCertificateTimestamp with embedSCTs), pkg/verify/tsa_test.go, pkg/verify/signed_entity_test.go

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Extend the duplicate-entry guard at pkg/verify/tlog.go:51-58 to error on any repeated log key ID (or dedupe the counter only), leaving the integrated-timestamp list and SCT counting untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: TSA dedup (pkg/verify/tsa.go:67-74) keys on trusted-root URI, while the tlog fix keys on log key ID; whether an operator with several keys/IDs in a trusted root counts as several witnesses is a trust-root policy question, not pursued.
